responsibility: Contains GCC’s main RTL combiner, which uses LOG_LINKS and local dataflow to substitute results of earlier single-set insns into later insns and thereby merge pairs, triplets, and selected quadruplets into fewer target-recognizable instructions. Beyond the core substitution and validation logic, it maintains combiner-specific register/value state, updates notes and links after successful merges, inserts extra pseudo-to-pseudo copies to avoid overexposing hard registers, and drives the "combine" RTL pass that can also trigger jump-label rebuilding and CFG cleanup.
